description: Defines classes and structures for NRPPa notifications, message handling, and related interactions within the ocudu::ocucp namespace, including UE and TRP information management.

classes.name: cell_measurement_positioning_info
classes.description: Holds cell measurement data including serving cell ID and measurements.

classes.name: nrppa_cu_cp_ue_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying about UE-specific NRPPa events.

classes.name: nrppa_f1ap_notifier
classes.description: Interface for signaling events to the F1AP related to positioning and measurement requests.

classes.name: trp_information_cu_cp_response_t
classes.description: Contains TRP information responses and associated notifiers for DUs.

classes.name: nrppa_cu_cp_notifier
classes.description: Interface for signaling events from NRPPa to CU-CP, including UE and TRP info requests.

classes.name: nrppa_message_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling incoming NRPPa messages.

classes.name: nrppa_interface
classes.description: Aggregates NRPPa message handling and UE removal interfaces.

methods.name: get_du_index
methods.description: Returns the DU index where the UE is connected.

methods.name: on_measurement_results_required
methods.description: Retrieves measurement results for the UE.

methods.name: schedule_async_task
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous task for the UE.

methods.name: on_positioning_information_request
methods.description: Handles positioning information requests to F1AP.

methods.name: on_positioning_activation_request
methods.description: Handles positioning activation requests to F1AP.

methods.name: on_measurement_information_request
methods.description: Handles measurement information requests to F1AP.

methods.name: on_new_nrppa_ue
methods.description: Notifies about a new NRPPa UE.

methods.name: get_nrppa_ue_context_removal_handler
methods.description: Returns the UE context removal handler.
